Brand Identity Design

Strength Socials

A bold, athlete first brand identity built to unite India’s strength sports community through competition, connection, and shared ambition.

CLIENTStrength Socials
OUR ROLEBrand Identity Design
SERVICEBranding & Graphic Design

THE PROJECT

Strength Socials

Introduction

Founded by passionate athletes, Strength Socials is committed to building a cohesive culture for strength sports in India. Despite a massive fitness fanbase, the community remained fragmented, the goal was to unite like-minded individuals to socialize, grow, and thrive together. Kyte built a flexible brand system that could thrive across competitions, social media, merchandise and future community experiences.

Mission & Vision

As athletes who’ve faced the hurdles of under-recognized sports, the mission was to level the field, creating opportunities for all to thrive through events that inspire, empower, and build a culture of integrity and excellence. The vision: a level playing field where every Indian athlete can thrive, championing fair play, elevating lesser-known sports, and inspiring future generations to pursue greatness.

Logo Design

The primary logo showcases a dynamic wordmark of “SS” that not only represents but also forms a shape symbolizing community and togetherness, with inviting and inclusive colors reflecting the event’s welcoming and collaborative spirit. The logo construction follows a meticulous grid system to ensure precision and harmony in its proportions, a structured framework allowing for consistent spacing, alignment, and balance, with a central stylized, robust figure maintaining proportionality and visual coherence throughout.

Color Palette

The system runs on a defined palette carrying its own meaning: SS Black (#181818), SS Grey Dark (#757575), SS Grey Mid (#A0A0A0) and SS Grey Light (#E0E0E0) for balance, SS White (#F7F7F7) for integrity, SS Blue (#59ABF1) for confidence, SS Green (#73DD57) for growth, SS Yellow (#FFD949) for energy, SS Orange (#FA8D13) for optimism, and SS Red (#F03F4C) for passion.

Typography & Iconography

Helvetica Neue was chosen as the primary typeface for its clean, modern, versatile design and strong readability, with Helvetica Neue Condensed as the secondary face. Each event emblem features the same central robust figure within a circular form symbolizing unity, recolored per discipline: SS Crossfit, SS Bodybuilding, SS Calisthenics, SS Marathon, SS Strongman and SS Powerlifting.

Imagery & Brand Voice

Strength Socials uses bold, high-contrast imagery that captures the intensity, energy, and determination of athletes, close-ups, dramatic angles, and vibrant colors to highlight strength and movement, alongside diverse group shots reflecting the brand’s inclusivity and support. The brand voice is built on fair play, integrity, and an “athlete first” approach, with inclusivity at its core, ensuring every individual feels valued in a transparent, respectful community.
